home.heroSubtitle: Philosophy, Culture and Spirituality for a New Era of Consciousness
home.organizationText1: The Civitas Solis Institute is a philosophical-cultural and non-profit organization dedicated to integral human development through the study and practice of humanity's perennial knowledge.
home.organizationText2: Founded with the purpose of promoting synthesis between science, art and spirituality, our institute seeks to contribute to the awakening of a new planetary consciousness, based on ancestral wisdom and contemporary discoveries.
home.organizationText3: Through publications, lectures, workshops and cultural projects, we work to disseminate knowledge that can positively transform people's lives and society as a whole.
home.scienceDesc: We explore the frontiers of scientific knowledge, integrating modern discoveries with ancient wisdom.
home.artDesc: We cultivate artistic expression as a way to awaken beauty and human sensitivity.
home.spiritualityDesc: We promote spiritual development through the study of universal philosophical traditions.

globalWork.title: Global Work
globalWork.subtitle: Our mission transcends geographical and cultural boundaries, connecting hearts and minds in search of a unified planetary consciousness.
globalWork.planetaryText1: The Civitas Solis Institute recognizes that humanity's contemporary challenges are global in nature and require solutions that transcend traditional divisions between nations, cultures and spiritual traditions. Our work is based on the understanding that there is an underlying unity that connects all beings and that true social transformation can only occur through the awakening of this universal consciousness.
globalWork.planetaryText2: Through an integral approach that honors both cultural diversity and the universal principles of perennial wisdom, we work to build bridges between East and West, between tradition and modernity, between science and spirituality.
globalWork.embassyText: We have the honor of maintaining a strategic partnership with the Embassy of the Free Mind, an international organization dedicated to preserving and disseminating the hermetic tradition and Western esoteric knowledge. This collaboration allows us to expand our reach and impact, connecting us with a global network of researchers, philosophers and truth seekers.
globalWork.partnershipText: This partnership exemplifies our commitment to international cooperation in the field of philosophical and spiritual studies. Together, we develop research projects, educational events and publications that contribute to a deeper understanding of humanity's wisdom traditions.
globalWork.initiativesText: Our global work manifests through various initiatives that seek to promote the evolution of human consciousness on a planetary scale:
globalWork.culturalExchangeDesc: We facilitate the exchange of knowledge between different cultural and spiritual traditions, promoting inter-religious and intercultural dialogue.
globalWork.holisticEducationDesc: We develop educational programs that integrate intellectual knowledge, emotional development and spiritual growth.
globalWork.initiativesText2: Through multilingual publications, international conferences, transformational workshops and digital platforms, we reach people on all continents, offering practical tools for personal development and positive social transformation.
globalWork.impactText1: Our global work has already touched the lives of thousands of people in dozens of countries, contributing to the awakening of a new generation of conscious leaders and transformation agents. We see growing evidence that a new planetary consciousness is emerging, a consciousness that recognizes the fundamental interconnection of all life and the urgent need for global cooperation.
globalWork.impactText2: Looking to the future, we continue to expand our network of international partners, develop new educational technologies and create increasingly inclusive spaces for dialogue between different wisdom traditions. Our vision is of a world where perennial wisdom informs global decisions and where authentic spirituality is recognized as fundamental to the well-being of humanity and the planet.

missionVisionValues.title: Mission, Vision & Values
missionVisionValues.subtitle: The principles that guide our journey towards a transformed planetary consciousness.
missionVisionValues.missionText: To promote integral human development through harmonious synthesis between science, art and spirituality, contributing to the awakening of a new planetary consciousness based on perennial wisdom and cooperation between all traditions of humanity.
missionVisionValues.visionText: To be recognized as a center of excellence in the integration of universal knowledge, inspiring a generation of conscious leaders capable of creating innovative solutions to global challenges, based on ancestral wisdom and contemporary science, contributing to building a more just, harmonious and sustainable civilization.
missionVisionValues.valuesSubtitle: Seven fundamental principles that guide all our actions and decisions.
missionVisionValues.respectDesc: We honor the dignity of every being and tradition
missionVisionValues.recognizeDesc: We value wisdom in all its forms
missionVisionValues.inspireDesc: We awaken the best in each person
missionVisionValues.valuesClosing: These values are not just words, but living principles that permeate every aspect of our work. They remind us of the responsibility we have to honor the wisdom of the past while building a more conscious and harmonious future for all humanity.

book.title: The Hidden Renaissance
book.subtitle: Rediscovering the Hermetic Mysteries that Transformed the World
book.description: A fascinating journey through the secret knowledge that influenced the great masters of the Renaissance, revealing how hermetic wisdom shaped our modern civilization.
book.bookDescription1: "The Hidden Renaissance" reveals the secrets behind humanity's greatest period of cultural flourishing. This meticulously researched book explores how hermetic knowledge, transmitted through secret societies and Platonic academies, influenced giants like Leonardo da Vinci, Marsilio Ficino, Pico della Mirandola and many others.
book.bookDescription2: This is not just a history book, but an invitation to reflect on how perennial knowledge can inform our contemporary search for meaning and transformation. An essential work for students of philosophy, art history, Western esotericism and all those interested in understanding the hidden roots of our civilization.
book.testimonial1: "A masterful work that brilliantly connects historical points. Essential for those seeking to understand the esoteric roots of Western culture."
book.testimonial2: "Impeccable research and engaging narrative. The book transforms our understanding of the Renaissance and its true masters."
book.testimonial3: "I couldn't stop reading! A fascinating journey through the mysteries that shaped our civilization. Highly recommended."
book.ctaText: Dive into the mysteries of the Renaissance and discover the secrets that transformed the world.
